## What changes?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the checks you ran. Include desktop/mobile screenshots for visual changes.

## Review checklist

- [ ] `bun run check` passes.
- [ ] Relevant docs and examples are updated.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, or personal deployment configuration are included.
- [ ] Changes to authentication, destinations, signing, or delivery semantics include regression coverage.
- [ ] I have read CONTRIBUTING.md and agree to contribute under the MIT license.
